summary: Pre-market: the composite risk score held essentially flat at 47.97 (trend_1d -0.01) with the regime still goldilocks, but the macro dimension at 64.09 remains the binding constraint — the 10-year real rate at 2.6 sits at the 100.0th percentile and the 10-year Treasury at 4.97 at the 99.92nd percentile, with the 2-year at 4.65 from 4.63. The session's event risk is the Fed decision: swap pricing implies 4.10 against an effective funds rate of 3.63, and the press reports the 10-year above 5%. Overnight Asia ran the mirror image of the US tape — all 11 tracked A-share names closed higher, led by 000021.SZ at 6.7532 percent and 688008.SH at 6.4207 percent, with press reports of KOSPI up 1.4 percent and an oil rally capped — while crypto stayed weak at bitcoin 75913 and ether 2401.49. In the last completed US session memory led at 3.0475 percent and networking at 1.3311 percent, yet only 7 of 22 sectors and themes advanced and fintech at -2.3728 percent and the EV supply chain at -2.2383 percent led the decline. Breadth has still not repaired: no new highs against a 0.1097 new-low ratio and 0.529 above the 200-day average, with semis lagging by 20.9613 percentage points. Caveat: the sector and theme block is flagged degraded, data quality 0.8.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation at 0.75 is the heaviest single contribution in the model at 7.50 weighted points, with the dollar index at 118.2126 and bitcoin at 75913 confirming that the risk-appetite tail is contracting rather than broadening.
The 10-year real rate held at 2.6, the 100.0th percentile of its history, carrying a risk score of 100.0 and contributing 5.00 weighted points — no headroom is left in the discount-rate channel.

The long end stayed pinned at cycle extremes: the 10-year Treasury printed 4.97 at the 99.92nd percentile and the 2-year 4.65, leaving the whole curve above an effective funds rate of 3.63 with the market pricing a hike at an implied 4.10.
Volatility repriced higher: VIX at 17.1 sits in the 44.13rd percentile and contributes 3.53 weighted points, while high-yield spreads widened to 2.71 from 2.65.

The liquidity cushion has drained: reverse repo fell to 0.7, the 5.06th percentile with a risk score of 89.88 and a 3.60 weighted contribution, while the Fed balance sheet sits at 6740619 and reserves at 2991310.

supporting_signals.claim: Breadth remains broken beneath a flat headline: the new-high ratio is 0.0 against a new-low ratio of 0.1097, and only 0.529 of the panel sits above its 200-day average.
Leadership stayed very narrow: only 7 of 22 sectors and themes advanced, with fintech at -2.3728 percent, the EV supply chain at -2.2383 percent and data centers at -1.2355 percent at the bottom.
Crypto extended its drawdown: bitcoin at 75913, ether at 2401.49 and SOL at 97.27, with bitcoin dominance at 0.585311 — the highest-beta end of the tape is still being sold.
Semis keep lagging: semis relative performance stands at -20.9613 percent and small caps at -3.5634 percent, so the advance stays concentrated in large caps.

contradicting_signals.claim: Credit has not confirmed any stress: high-yield spreads at 2.71 sit in the 13.25th percentile and investment-grade at 0.8 in the 30.23rd.
The regime and trend structure are intact: goldilocks, price 5.9129 percent above the 200-day average and realized volatility at just 8.8202.
Asia closed the opposite way: all 11 tracked A-share names finished higher, led by 000021.SZ at 6.7532 percent, 688008.SH at 6.4207 percent and 300223.SZ at 5.0792 percent.
Funding plumbing shows no stress even with the cushion drained: reverse repo is down to 0.7 but reserves stand at 2991310 and SOFR has held at 3.62.

what_changed_today: The composite held at 47.97 with a one-day trend of -0.01, leaving the macro dimension at 64.09 as the only binding constraint.
The curve shifted higher: the 10-year Treasury to 4.97 from 4.96 and the 2-year to 4.65 from 4.63, while the real rate held at 2.6 at the 100.0th percentile.

Memory flipped to the top of the theme table at 3.0475 percent and networking reached 1.3311 percent, while fintech at -2.3728 percent and the EV supply chain at -2.2383 percent led the decline; only 7 of 22 advanced.
Risk premia moved together: VIX rose to 17.1 from 15.84, high-yield spreads widened to 2.71 from 2.65, and cross-asset confirmation stepped up to 0.75.
The liquidity buffer thinned further: reverse repo dropped to 0.7 from 1.42 on a Fed balance sheet of 6740619.
The tracked A-share panel closed decisively higher, all 11 names up, led by 000021.SZ at 6.7532 percent and 688008.SH at 6.4207 percent.
watch_next: Today's Fed decision and the guidance that follows: swap pricing implies 4.10 against an effective funds rate of 3.63, so the question is whether further hikes are signalled.
US Advance Retail Sales at 12:30Z on 2026-09-16, the only high-importance print in the calendar window ahead of the FOMC meeting listed for 2026-09-28.
Whether the memory bid holds its lead at 3.0475 percent on reports of US memory manufacturing talks, given that only 7 of 22 themes advanced.
Whether the real rate at 2.6 and the 10-year at 4.97 extend further: both sit at the top of their ranges and a break higher would compress valuations again.
Whether breadth repairs from a 0.0 new-high ratio and a 0.1097 new-low ratio, and whether VIX holds above 15.84.

bull_case.title: Bull case: a hike delivered without an escalation signal, memory leadership broadening and credit stress absent pull the composite back below 45
points: If the Fed delivers the priced hike without guiding further, the 2-year at 4.65 and the real rate at 2.6 can retreat and release a macro dimension that sits at 64.09.
The memory complex is the one broadening bid: memory at 3.0475 percent and networking at 1.3311 percent led, and the tracked A-share panel closed all 11 higher.
Credit has confirmed nothing: high-yield spreads at 2.71 and investment-grade at 0.8, so a volatility retreat from 17.1 toward the 8.8202 realized level would repair the 0.75 cross-asset reading.

base_case.title: Base case: the macro constraint holds near 64 and the composite oscillates between 45 and 50 through the Fed decision
points: The real rate at 2.6 sits at the 100.0th percentile with no visible downside trigger, keeping the macro dimension near 64.09.
Breadth stays narrow — a 0.0 new-high ratio and a 0.1097 new-low ratio — so gains and losses stay confined to a handful of themes such as memory at 3.0475 percent.

bear_case.title: Bear case: an escalation signal plus a further long-end break push the composite above 50
points: If the Fed signals continued hikes, the 10-year at 4.97 and the real rate at 2.6 push into new extremes and equity structure at 54.54 deteriorates further from a 0.1097 new-low ratio.
A cushion already drained — reverse repo at 0.7 in the 5.06th percentile — leaves little room if reserves at 2991310 stop rising.
Crypto would amplify the move: bitcoin at 75913, ether at 2401.49 and SOL at 97.27 are already contracting alongside a cross-asset confirmation of 0.75.
